title: SpargeInput
description: Normalized input for planning the sparge: water temperature and, for batch sparging, how many runs the mash tun needs. Decoupled from BeerJSON: an adapter extracts these fields from a Recipe and an equipment profile.

method.description: 'fly' = continuous sparge: water trickles onto a grain bed already near the target, so it goes in at the target temperature. 'batch' = drain, add a run of water, stir, drain: each run mixes with the bed and has to bring it up to the target.

sparge_water_l.description: Total sparge water, in liters (from the water calc).

grain_absorption_l_per_kg.description: Water held by the grain after draining, in L/kg. It stays at mash temperature and has to be heated by the first run.

mash_dead_space_l.description: Wort left under the false bottom after draining, in liters.

mash_temp_c.description: Grain bed temperature at the end of the mash (last rest), in °C.

target_bed_temp_c.description: Grain bed temperature to reach during the sparge, in °C. Typical: 75-77 °C. Above ~80 °C the bed releases tannins.

mash_tun_capacity_l.description: Mash tun volume, in liters. Batch sparge only: a run must fit alongside the drained grain, so a smaller tun splits the water into more runs. Omit for a single run.

grain_specific_heat_ratio.description: Ratio of grain's specific heat to water's. Standard homebrew approximation: 0.41 (Palmer, 'How to Brew').
